test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who criticises traditional beliefs and customs
solution: The correct answer is '**Iconoclast**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Iconoclast**'. • **Iconoclast** - (एक व्यक्ति जो पोषित विश्वासों, रीति-रिवाजों या संस्थानों पर हमला करता है या उनकी आलोचना करता है): A person who attacks or criticizes cherished beliefs, customs, or institutions. • *Example: The **iconoclast** questioned the traditional notions of beauty in art and sought to challenge the established norms of artistic expression.* • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.** **Correct Answer:__** *Iconoclast.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Heretic** - (विधर्मी): A person who holds controversial opinions, especially ones that contradict the accepted doctrines of a religion, philosophy, or ideology. • **Absconder** - (भगोड़ा): A person who has fled or escaped from a place, especially to avoid arrest or prosecution. • **Apostle** - (प्रवर्तक; एक व्यक्ति जिसे एक मिशन पर भेजा जाता है या एक व्यक्ति जो किसी कारण, सिद्धांत या विचार का उत्साही समर्थक होता है): A person who is sent on a mission or a person who is an enthusiastic supporter of a cause, principle, or idea. 194:Tef6, The correct answer is* **'A lot of coffee was drunk by him before the marathon.'***
